scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on their account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Darnell Robinson and I'm 29. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Darnell, I'm sorry to hear you're concerned about an unrecognized charge. I would be happy to help you investigate this. To get started, could you please provide the last four digits of your account number and the date of birth associated with the profile for security verification?
Sure, the last four are 8842, and my birthday is May 12, 1995.

Thank you for verifying that. I have pulled up your transaction history. I see a charge for $76.00 from 'Global Tech Services' on October 14th. Does that name sound familiar, or would you like me to pull up the merchant contact details for you?
No, that doesn't ring a bell at all. I definitely didn't buy anything from a tech service company.

I understand. Per our Fraud Protection Policy, if a transaction is unauthorized, we initiate a formal dispute process. I have reviewed the transaction, and since it is flagged as a 'card-not-present' purchase, I am initiating a dispute now. This will temporarily credit your account for the $76 while our investigation team reviews the merchant's claim.
That sounds great, thank you. How long does the investigation usually take?

The investigation typically takes 7 to 10 business days. I have successfully processed the provisional credit, which should reflect in your balance within the next hour. You will receive a confirmation email with your case reference number shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized nature of the charge, and initiated a formal dispute with a provisional credit as per company fraud policy.
